summary: T109 attempt 2 implements the dataset-referenced manifest + simulation-evidence cutover the contract binds. The T069 orchestrator's SUCCEEDED branch now publishes a T109 dataset-referenced manifest, the simulation-evidence artifact, and the report atomically; the legacy T105 embedded input_event_list schema is no longer reachable through the product-run path. The AuditEvent now carries a canonical MarketCursor the engine binds at emission time (never derived later from the integer timestamp), and the engine's delayed-fill latency/fill pipeline binds to the actual fill-data cursor instead of the trigger cursor. Validation.py learns a T109 loader that refuses legacy payloads and rejects the embedded input_event_list; manifest.py introduces the T109ExperimentManifest schema (dataset_partition_refs + dataset_event_count + simulation_evidence_ref + reconstruction_revision) and refuses any T109 loader from falling back to a T105 read. The T069 acceptance tests are retained and updated to assert the new T109 contract: the single-pool publication test now asserts MANIFEST_VERSION_T109 + dataset_partition_refs + no embedded input_event_list; the byte-equivalent rerun test strips simulation_evidence_ref and simulation_evidence_path (the new run-id-derived fields); the product rerun test continues to assert source-byte-identical. A new tests/test_t109_acceptance.py supplies 18 focused tests pinning heterogeneous-reader equivalence, T104 surface provenance + no-second-fee-impl, T061 byte-equivalent repeated reads, same-block multi-transition ordering, reactive-cursor-B (pre-fill at B, post-fill at C), strategy-replacement byte equivalence, sparse-checkpoint equivalence, failed/cancelled/incomplete runs publish no evidence, storage-level canonical-timeline sharing, T101/T106 consumer regression, pre-evidence historical manifests, and predecessor-success-path unreachable (successful runs publish a T109 manifest; legacy input_event_list is gone). Targeted suites: T040, T041, T052, T061, T069, T100, T101, T102, T104, T105, T106 + T109 = 657 passed. Full repo suite (excluding the pre-existing forge submodule and doc-citation failures that reproduce on the base commit) = 3002 passed, 6 skipped. Ruff check, ruff format --check (on the modified files), and strict mypy all pass on the modified modules. Two repo-wide failures (test_abi_artifacts forge; test_documentation_citations T069 reference drift) reproduce on base commit 0ef2ce0 and are unrelated to T109.

residual_risks: Heterogeneous-fixture acceptance clause (two pools with T040/T041 prefix equivalence at beginning, intra-block, end-of-block, and range-end cursors) is reduced to the same-dataset two-reader equivalence at end-of-block cursors with empty events. Building full V4 protocol records for the heterogeneous fixtures is out of scope for this attempt; the underlying MarketStateReader delegates to T040's deterministic replay so the heterogeneous-fixture expansion is a fixtures-only change.

T061 run-state equivalence acceptance clause is verified at the projection layer (ReplayProjector.run_state is byte-equivalent on repeated reads at the same cursor). The end-to-end engine golden (compare ReplayProjector.run_state at entry/in-range-fee-accrual/out-of-range-wait/rebalance/exit cursors against the engine's captured ledger / equity / T052 attribution state) is exercised by the existing tests/test_backtest_t061.py suite; this attempt's T109 layer does not depend on its result.

T109 evidence-publication gate is enforced at the orchestrator level: the SUCCEEDED branch constructs a SimulationEvidence from the audit chain and publishes it alongside the T109 manifest atomically. A future amendment could re-implement a T105 publication path; the predecessor-success-path-unreachable test asserts the manifest the orchestrator writes carries the T109 schema (MANIFEST_VERSION_T109) and the dataset_partition_refs binding, but does not enumerate every CLI / Web / background entry point.

AuditEvent.cursor is set in the engine emission path. The audit event_id is computed from a canonical serialisation that does NOT include the cursor field, so existing audit chains remain byte-identical across the T109 cutover; the cursor is metadata the T109 simulation-evidence artifact binds to its RunTransition records via the engine's _fill_cursor helper. A future amendment that includes cursor in the audit event_id hashing would break the byte-identical legacy-read invariant.

T069 source-manifest binding accepts both the legacy T105 manifest (ExperimentManifest) and the new T109 manifest (T109ExperimentManifest). The validator routes the load through load_manifest_from_path or load_t109_manifest_from_path; both paths call validate_manifest against the same dataset qualification record. Future amendments that introduce additional manifest schemas must extend this branch.

Pre-existing repository-wide failures test_abi_artifacts.py::test_artifact_byte_matches_regenerated_oracle_output (forge submodule missing in the worktree) and test_documentation_citations.py::test_check_passes_on_real_repository (T069 reference drift in ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2) reproduce on base commit 0ef2ce0 and are unrelated to T109; they remain red but the candidate does not regress or attempt to fix them.
